name: Cloudflare Agents Voice
note: Voice pipeline in the Agents SDK
summary: The voice channel of Cloudflare's Agents SDK streams microphone audio to an agent over a WebSocket and plays synthesized speech back, with continuous speech-to-text, streaming text-to-speech, voice activity detection and interruption handling. Built-in providers run Deepgram models on Workers AI, and add-ons connect ElevenLabs, Deepgram and Telnyx telephony.
facts: WebSocket, no SFU or meeting infrastructure
Deepgram Flux (default) or Nova-3 on Workers AI
Deepgram Aura-1 on Workers AI; ElevenLabs add-on
goodFor: Adding voice to an existing Cloudflare agent
watchOut: Chained speech-to-text and text-to-speech, not a speech-to-speech model
